scholarships.title: Alan and Jane Handler Endowed Scholarship

existing.description: With a permanently endowed fund, the Alan and Jane Handler Scholarship is awarded to selected students who do not otherwise have the financial means to attain a URochester education.
eligibility: First-year applicant for the fall term at the University of Rochester
Domestic or international applicant; both are eligible
Resiliency in the face of complex challenges
High financial need as demonstrated on the CSS Profile and FAFSA
Must have overcome significant obstacles in their lives
A nomination is required from a recommender who is not related to the prospective student
Nominations are not accepted from students or parents
existing.eligibility_summary: First-year, fall-term domestic and international applicants to the University of Rochester with demonstrated academic excellence, potential to be future leaders, resilience in the face of complex challenges and high financial need as shown on the CSS Profile and FAFSA. Transfer and spring-term applicants are not eligible. A nomination is required from a recommender who is not related to the applicant, and nominations are not accepted from students or parents.
benefits: Complete financial support for the regular four-year academic programme: tuition, mandatory fees, housing, food, books, personal expenses and transportation
Enrichment fund of up to $5,000 across the four-year experience for summer courses, study abroad or academic and professional needs
Access to a special alumni network of past Handler Scholars
Eligibility for additional RIG, REACH and Discover funding for summer internships and undergraduate research
coverage: Tuition and mandatory fees for up to eight semesters or until the first bachelor's degree requirements are met
Housing, whether on or off campus
Additional summer funding through the RIG, REACH and Discover programmes
requirements: Submit the admission application and the FAFSA and CSS Profile by the December 1 priority deadline; no additional Handler materials are required from the student
The application need not be submitted as Early Decision; a Regular Decision application by December 1 is acceptable and is not binding
Be nominated by an eligible third party during the September 15 to November 30 window, since the University does not accept nominations from students or parents
Demonstrate substantial financial need on the CSS Profile and FAFSA
Maintain Satisfactory Academic Progress as defined by the University and the Federal SAP Policy to renew the award
Apply for financial aid annually by March 15 for full consideration on renewal
Notify the dedicated Handler financial aid counsellor of any fees in order for awards to be adjusted
documents: University of Rochester first-year admission application
Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA)
Third-party nomination from a high school or independent counsellor, teacher or community-based organisation official, submitted during the September 15 to November 30 window
Academic transcripts as required for admission
existing.english_requirement: Not stated on the Handler Scholarship page. International first-year applicants are eligible and must meet the University of Rochester's standard undergraduate admission requirements, which include English proficiency expectations for applicants whose schooling was not in English.
application_method: Submit the University of Rochester first-year admission application, using either Early Decision or Regular Decision by December 1
Complete the FAFSA and the CSS Profile so that financial need can be assessed
Ask a high school or independent counsellor, teacher or community-based organisation official to submit a nomination between September 15 and November 30
Students who are admitted and submit all materials on time receive a financial aid award letter shortly after their admission notification
existing.selection_notes: The scholarship was established in 2007 with a gift from Rich and Martha Handler, honours Alan and Jane Handler, parents of Richard Handler, and represents the largest scholarship gift in the University's history. Scholars are selected on academic excellence, outstanding potential to be future leaders and demonstrated mastery of complex challenges. Finalists are notified by email in mid-February and attend a mandatory virtual interview event, with recipients notified in late spring. Nominating a student does not guarantee acceptance or receipt of the scholarship, and the award cannot be layered with another University of Rochester institutional merit scholarship.
existing.best_fit: First-year fall-term applicants, domestic or international, with an outstanding academic record, demonstrated resilience and high financial need, who can also obtain a nomination from a high school counsellor, teacher or community organisation official.
existing.notes: Although the award is a full four-year cost-of-attendance package, it is strictly need-based and is limited to first-year fall-term applicants. For students admitted to the Dual Degree in Nursing programme, the scholarship covers the first eight of ten semesters, with limited School of Nursing funding available for the final two. The Handler Scholarship cannot be combined with another University of Rochester institutional merit scholarship, but recipients may still seek RIG, REACH and Discover summer funding on top.
existing.duration: Four years, covering tuition and mandatory fees for up to eight semesters or until the first bachelor's degree requirements are met, whichever comes first
existing.application_period: Annual. Third-party nomination window 15 September to 30 November, then the applicant admission and financial aid deadline of 1 December. The 2027 entry cycle is currently open, with the nomination window running now and the applicant deadline on 1 December 2026.
existing.deadline_display: Official wording: "Nominations will open September 15 and close November 30. Please note, we do not accept nominations from students or parents." And "The application does not have to be submitted as Early Decision, but should be submitted by December 1." Students do not apply separately for the scholarship; they are considered automatically by submitting the admission application together with the FAFSA and CSS Profile by the December 1 priority deadline. For renewal, financial aid must be applied for annually by March 15.
